description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing facility. This is a pivotal leadership opportunity to oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency.The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader with a passion for enhancing the lives of residents and fostering a positive work environment for staff. You will be instrumental in driving quality outcomes and maintaining the facility's reputation for excellence.Join a team committed to providing exceptional care and making a significant impact in the community. This role offers a chance to shape the future of a dynamic healthcare environment.
requirements: Current and valid Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Demonstrated ability to manage operations, financial performance, and quality outcomes
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and team-building skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.
